measurement_limits: Parent balanced bank and new48 were already correct before fitting; matched continuation measures confidence/coverage/transfer, not repair of new-bank classification errors.
Original TRAIN/validation are exposed numerical cohorts; v3/sealed60/balanced48 labels do not select checkpoints and no fresh semantic holdout claim is made.
Endpoint source-bank argmax is distinct from greedy formula generation. This phase saves36 original greedy panels but no new48 postfit greedy rollout; later posthoc observation is separate.
Full32 source auxiliary loss is recomputed from stored logits; original decoder teacher-forced CE is an owner-reported aggregate without raw full-token logits.
Identity/projection MSE is not independently learned semantic reconstruction. Shared global clipping can affect all updates; source-only auxiliary forward ownership is not causal isolation.
Typed state hashes are recomputed from saved float32/int64 serialized values without constructing numerical tensors.
Frozen legal_formula_codec._rule schema validation and historical import-tree logs do not grant compiler execution, Lean admission or canonical working-tree throughput evidence.
Resource and lease samples are bounded observations; neither process peak RSS nor continuous lease coverage is claimed.
scientific_interpretation: Both matched continuations preserve all original conditioned TRAIN/validation formulas. The balanced-wording arm improves new-bank modality confidence but regresses old normative source-head modality accuracy from180 to170 of180, while the control arm preserves old180. This is a confidence/wording-transfer tradeoff on exposed authored meanings, not new-bank classification repair or heldout/proof success.

timing.scope: Two fresh-optimizer170-step numerical fits plus original exposed panels/source-bank readouts using cached384 features and frozen historical owners; no encoder/native compiler/Lean/end-to-end speed claim.
